You should try the following : check your connection, disable ad-blocker, clear your browser cache, try in private mode, try from another browser/computer/connection. 0 Go Fish Go Fish is a standard deck playing card game and is one of the first card games taught to children in the United States. Players are seeking to complete books consisting of four of the same number cards. After dealing cards to each player, players take turns asking another player if they have a card matching one in their hand. If a player has the requested card type, they give them to the asking player, and the asking player asks for a type of card from any other player again. If a player doesn't have the card requested, they say 'Go Fish' and the asking player draws from the draw pile. A draw which results in the last card asked for or in a complete book means the asking player gets another turn. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Overview The aim is to collect sets of 4 matching cards Turn If you have a card, you can ask another player for cards of the same rank. If they have those cards, they must give you all copies. If they don't, you draw a card from the draw pile. If the rank of the drawn card is what you asked last or the card completes a 4 of a kind, you get another turn. Scoring Each time you hold 4 of the same card, you declare this and place them out to show as a "Book" When either the deck runs out or someone empties their hand, the player with the most Books wins Board Game Arena would like to thank for making it possible to have this game here. 1633 gofish العربية беларуская мова български език Brezhoneg Català čeština Dansk Deutsch Ελληνικά English Español Eesti keel فارسی Suomi Français Galego עברית Hrvatski Magyar Italiano Bahasa Indonesia 日本語 한국어 Lietuvių Latviešu Bahasa Malaysia Nederlands Norsk Polski Português Română Русский язык Slovenčina Slovenščina Српски Svenska ไทย Türkçe Українська мова Tiếng Việt 中文 (漢) 中文 (汉) Application loading... ... {DISPLAY_IN_OTHER_LANG} {LANG_REDIRECT_CODE} boardgamearena.com Top Help What is Board Game Arena? [Rating: 1/10] This game is like a rite of passage among children.  Thus, the decline of Western civilization...

[Rating: 1/10] Asking for cards isn't a game, it's a lottery. Ok, it's an introduction to what a card deck looks like for kids, but that's about all it's good for.

[Rating: 1/10] Luck + memory = kill me now.  But it's preferred by some non-gaming parents to Ticket to Ride, 7 Wonders, and other "complicated, stressful strategy games that require too much thinking".

[Rating: 1/10] The rules literally support and encourage cheating and luck.  I hated this game when i was a kid and i hate it now.

[Rating: 1/10] A children's game of guessing the hand of others. If you're right you get the cards if not, you go fish!
